The '''Black Sun bunker''' was a base located on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was operated by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].

==History==
{{Quote|I know that you found a spice sample, the local Black Sun leaders were talking about it earlier today. That's why they set up that trap for you. They want a piece of the action. I don't know the name of this spice, but it seems to be medicinal in nature, and rare.|[[Tover Blackmoor]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />}}
The bunker was located in the [[Vaydean Marsh]] region of Rori and was used by the Black Sun, one of the most powerful criminal syndicate in the galaxy, as its headquarters on the moon. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Black Sun discovered that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was smuggling a new kind of [[Syren spice|spice]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Black Sun acquired a sample of this new spice after the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Cal Handro]] crash-landed on Rori. The [[Chemist/Legends|chemist]] [[Tover Blackmoor]] analyzed the spice in the bunker and discovered that it was nothing like any other spice available on the marker.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />

The Black Sun leaders therefore decided to obtain more of that spice and started to track Cal Handro, the missing pilot who vanished after his ship crashed. They also set up a trap for a group of spacers who had found spice in Handro's crashed ship while searching for the missing pilot. A woman by the name [[Kaila Min]] contacted the spacers and pretended to have met the pilot on the run in the wilderness of Rori. The adventurers indeed rushed to the coordinates provided by the woman, only to be attacked by the Black Sun. However, the spacers killed all attackers and found the coordinates of the Black Sun bunker on a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. The spacers then attacked the bunker, hoping to find the missing pilot, and killed many Black Sun henchmen during the assault. They eventually found the chemist Tover Blackmoor and forced him to reveal everything he knew about the pilot and the new spice.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Black Sun bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Black Sun bunker was added to the game with the second chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" quest line, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes: March 24, 2005|Publish 14.1]]," on [[March 24]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 14.1 - March 24, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=734|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.1 - March 24, 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
